page.notes: The Greek word after "multorum" is not legible at this scan resolution; it is marked illegible rather than guessed. The italic/roman boundaries in the first lines are uncertain. "ignari" is followed by a stray mark that may be a comma or a printing flaw; it is transcribed as a comma. "Episcopa-" continues on the next page as "tum" (the catchword). The "3." before the heading is a bare number and is set as a paragraph.
